steps.text: BUG-32a / BUG-72: the last traveller's payoff before the report; the day's end, Go Home and Sleep recorded for 'cuts' (no single-frame full-screen change), each from before the click to the settled scene, so a cut on the click's own frame or as the new scene comes in is seen. 'frozen' is not read on them: the report before the click and the settled scene after the shutter may hold still; the loads' frozen is read over each load alone (flow_shutter in the editor, flow_load_seq on the QA player; FLOW round 7); the closing bell on an early finish
